key_findings: With-skill found 2x more violations on the full audit (37 vs 18) while using FEWER tokens (86k vs 106k)
Baseline DISMISSED prompt CVE placeholders as 'Non-Violations' — the skill correctly flagged them
Baseline used severity tiers (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) despite user wanting flat reporting — skill followed format
Baseline had no Clean Layers section — skill included it per template
On narrower scans (eval 2, 3), both performed well on core assertions, but skill went further with additional phases
The with-skill prompt-scan agent proactively ran Phase 1/2 sweeps and found 23 extra violations beyond the prompt focus
non_discriminating_assertions: Eval 3 assertions: both with-skill and baseline scored 5/5 — import scanning is straightforward enough that the skill doesn't add much
Eval 2 core assertions: both found the 2 prompt violations — the baseline was equally thorough for the narrow prompt question
analysis.where_skill_matters_most: The full audit (eval 1) is where the skill shines — it provides a systematic procedure that catches more violations, avoids severity softening, and follows the report format. Without the skill, the agent invents its own severity tiers and dismisses borderline findings.
